Lina V: FYI — scheduled cross-region peering rotation + synthetic-load injection next Tue 2025-08-05 03:00-05:00 UTC. Affects control-plane calls between eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Expected short-lived control-plane 502s (usually <90s per region). No model weight changes or customer data movement.
Theo R: Will this impact hosted API latency? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Lina V: Data-plane for inference should remain steady; control-plane ops (deploys, evictions, scale API) may return transient errors. We'll activate client-side retry/backoff for control-plane endpoints and apply a temporary SLO relaxation for deploy ops only.
SRE Oncall: Canary plan? Rollback thresholds?
Lina V: Canary at 02:30 UTC on peering-proxy-1 (1% control-plane traffic). Ramp to 10% at 02:45, full flip at 03:00-03:20 with staged route announcements. Rollback immediate if control-plane error rate > 1.5x baseline or burn-rate crosses threshold. Rollback target: revert BGP sessions within 60s.
InfraBot: Maintenance job scheduled: peering-rot-20250805 queued. Job: https://redwood.internal/ops/peering-rot-20250805
Product Ops: We'll send a short advisory to customers in EU/NA with the expected window and suggested mitigations.
Lina V: We're also running a targeted synthetic load test during the window (traffic generator `synthgen-v2`) to validate routing behavior under degraded peering. To opt out for your service add header `X-Rw-NoSynth: true` for the test period or add tag `synth-optout` to your service config. See snippet below.
```
# Opt-out curl example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-Rw-NoSynth: true" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/status
```
QA Eng: Will SLOs be adjusted for the window?
Lina V: Short-term SLO adjustment: control-plane deploy latency p99 relaxed from 750ms -> 1500ms for the 03:00-04:00 UTC window only. No changes to inference p99 SLOs or customer-facing SLA. We'll monitor burn and revert early if safe.
Theo R: Who gets paged on model-health regressions or unexpected errors?
SRE Oncall: Page SRE Oncall + Lina V + Theo R. The runbook contact list includes infra and runtime leads.
Lina V: We'll post live status updates in this thread through the operation and a concise postmortem within 48h. If you want to join the preflight check at 02:00 UTC, ping me here.
InfraBot: Reminder: 60 minutes until peering-rot-20250805 starts (2025-08-05T02:00:00Z).
